reviewSummary.overallAssessment: This month's activity is concentrated on a single project (3e70f9b8) and reveals a company actively processing supplier invoices for wall linings labour work, with a secondary structural timber materials line. All 10 allocations are manually processed with no AI assistance accepted. The dominant operational signal is that wall linings labour (07.01.LAB) is the core active cost type on this project, with recurring invoice lines being matched against a single PO line item. A subset of invoices carry unclassified, unmatched lines that have been deliberately approved through a QA gate, suggesting a conscious cost control and review discipline. One allocation has been reversed and superseded, indicating active cost correction behaviour.
